source_block.parva: Karna Parva · seventeenth day of Kurukshetra · the Karna–Arjuna dvairatha, the serpent-mouthed arrow, the sunken chariot wheel, Krishna's rebuke and Karna's fall (karna-vadha)
source_block.bori: BORI CE Karna Parva, Debroy translation vol. 7: 8.63 the two chariots meet, beings take sides; 8.64–8.65 the duel (Ashvatthama's plea for peace, not depicted); 8.66.5–19 the serpent-mouthed arrow, Shalya's advice and 'Karna does not fix an arrow twice' (8.66.8), Krishna presses the chariot down, the crown falls, Arjuna binds his hair with a white cloth; 8.66.42 the wheel sinks through the Brahmin's curse and Rama's weapon is not recalled; 8.66.59–65 Karna's plea; 8.67.1–6 Vasudeva's rebuke; 8.67.12–20 the standard felled and the anjalika loosed; 8.67.24–33 Karna falls in the afternoon, his radiance enters the sky; 8.68 conchs and Shalya's return. Background: 8.29 the curses; Udyoga 5.138–139 Krishna tells Karna his birth; Stri 11.27 Kunti's disclosure.
source_block.gita_press: Gita Press Gorakhpur Mahabharata (Hindi, Karna Parva, vulgate numbering = Ganguli): adhyaya 87 the meeting and the gods taking sides; adhyaya 90 the sarpamukha arrow, Shalya's advice, Krishna sinking the chariot, the kirita lost, the Brahmana's curse and the stuck wheel (colophon: Karna's chariot wheel caught in the earth); adhyaya 91 Shri Krishna's warning (where was dharma then?), the standard cut, the Anjalika, Karna's death in the afternoon (aparahne), his radiance merging into the sun's orb, and the conchs of Krishna and Arjuna.
source_block.ganguli: K.M. Ganguli, Karna Parva §87 (meeting; Surya and Shakra take sides), §90 (serpent arrow; 'Karna never aimeth an arrow twice'; car pressed down a cubit; diadem lost; white cloth; Brahmana's curse; brahmastra forgotten; left wheel devoured; 'wait for a moment'), §91 (Krishna's rebuke; standard cut; Anjalika 'possessed of the effulgence of the thousand-rayed Sun'; 'cut off the head of Vaikartana in the afternoon'; 'a light passing through the welkin penetrated the sun'; conchs). Background: §42 the curses; Udyoga §140 Krishna's disclosure; Stri §27 Kunti's.
source_block.divergence: Which wheel: the vulgate (Ganguli §90, Gita Press 90) has the earth devour the LEFT wheel; BORI CE 8.66.61 speaks of the wheel generically / the 'middle' — we narrate only 'Karna's wheel' and paint the near (left) wheel. Karna's radiance: CE 8.67.27 says it plunged into the sky; the vulgate says it entered the sun's orb — we narrate 'climbs into the sky' and only paint the light rising toward the sun, calling Karna 'son of the Sun' (both editions). Krishna's rebuke: the vulgate adds Abhimanyu's killing to the list; CE does not — we narrate only Draupadi in a single cloth and the laughter, which both carry. Omitted for length: Vrishasena's death (8.62), Ashvatthama's plea for peace (8.64), Bhima–Dushasana (8.61), the Ashvasena naga's second attempt, and the weapon-for-weapon exchanges after the wheel sinks. Karna's beheading is narrated as 'Karna falls' — no head, no body on any plate.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press + BORI/Debroy overlap: the meeting with heaven taking sides, the serpent-mouthed arrow with Shalya's advice and Karna's refusal to aim twice, Krishna pressing the chariot down so the arrow takes only the crown, the wheel seized by the earth through the Brahmin's curse with Parashurama's weapon forgotten, Karna's plea, Krishna's rebuke over Draupadi, the standard cut and the Anjalika like a sunbeam, the fall in the afternoon with a light rising, and the victory conchs. Ganguli for English wording. Kunti's secret per Udyoga (Krishna knows) and Stri (Arjuna learns after the war).
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology only; no gore, no bodies, no severed head. Draupadi, Kunti, Surya, Indra, the cursing Brahmin and Parashurama are narrated only, never drawn. Krishna = Ep 04 lock (official, Avinash 2026-10-05); Arjuna = Ep 14/15 lock (crown until beat crown, white cloth after); Karna = Ep 13 lock via Ep 16; Shalya = Ep 16 lock. One new scene master (field17, afternoon daylight). Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or any finished plate as an Imagine ref. Picks up Ep 16's end line; Shalya's command (eighteenth day) is Ep 18.
